changelog:
- Initial release of the paywall-upgrade-cro skill.
- Provides comprehensive guidance for creating and optimizing in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, and feature gates.
- Focuses on converting free users to paid or encouraging upgrades at key in-product moments after users have experienced value.
- Includes best practices for feature gating, usage limits, trial expiration, and timing/frequency of upgrade prompts.
- Offers actionable templates, core principles, anti-patterns to avoid, and suggestions for effective A/B testing.
- Distinguishes in-product paywall optimization from public pricing pages and other related skills.
